name: get_domain_verification_record
description:
Get the TXT verification record needed to claim ownership of a domain for the authenticated team. The record must be added at `_vercel.{domain}` in the domain's DNS settings. This tool only returns the record; it does not claim the domain.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v9/domains/{domain}/verification --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

domain.description: The domain name to get the verification record for

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
